en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to help students choose the topic of the final thesis according to the chosen specialization and to acquaint students with the requirements and attributes of creating bachelor's theses, including appropriate time management. At the same time, the student acquires the competence to work with information sources.
